title: The New Park
description: Two friends spend a Saturday at a new park in town.
instructions: Read the text about a new park, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: There is a new park in our town. It opened last month. It has a big pond, a playground and many trees.
On Saturday, I went to the park with my friend Nora. We fed bread to the ducks on the pond. Then we played on the swings.
There is also a small cafe in the park. We bought two ice creams there. Nora's ice cream was chocolate. Mine was strawberry.
After our ice creams, we walked around the pond. There is a small bridge over the water. We stood on the bridge and looked at the fish. Some of the fish were orange and very big.
Near the playground, there is a big field. Some boys played football there. A man was flying a red kite. It went very high in the sky. Nora said, 'I want a kite too!'
At three o'clock, it was very hot. Then Nora's dad came with their little dog, Bobby. We all sat under a tall tree. It was cool in the shade. Bobby drank some water and slept on the grass.
At five o'clock, Nora's dad took us home. I told my mum about the park. 'Can we go again next week?' I asked. She said, 'Yes, and I will come too!' The new park is my favourite place in town now.
